Live-contact exception: the change is control flow for the case where live contact FAILS, so a recorded successful response cannot exercise it. The CI Summary poll's reads of its own job listing are unchanged in shape and still reach the GitHub API; what changes is that a failed read no longer truncates jobs.json, is counted, has its gh error captured, and is reported as an unreadable input rather than as pending gates. Its live contact is the 2026-11-07 outage itself -- 90 consecutive failed reads of repos/OmniNode-ai/omnibase_infra/actions/runs/42397877196/jobs across the whole 90m window, with the resulting false "57 gates missing/pending" verdict quoted in the PR body -- and the first pull_request run of CI Summary on this branch. The tests drive the step's own shell extracted from ci.yml with a gh that fails the way that outage did and a controlled clock, which is the only way to reach the changed branches; four of the five fail at the merge base (OMN-23027).
